Package org.apache.poi.ss.formula.ptg

Class Ref3DPxg

java.lang.Object
org.apache.poi.ss.formula.ptg.Ptg
org.apache.poi.ss.formula.ptg.OperandPtg
org.apache.poi.ss.formula.ptg.RefPtgBase
org.apache.poi.ss.formula.ptg.Ref3DPxg
All Implemented Interfaces:
Duplicatable, GenericRecord, Pxg, Pxg3D
public final class Ref3DPxg extends RefPtgBase implements Pxg3D
XSSF 3D Reference

Defines a cell in an external or different sheet.

This is XSSF only, as it stores the sheet / book references in String form. The HSSF equivalent using indexes is Ref3DPtg
